## to create healthier futures.

reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.

manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,

from being part of a community.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Breaking Financial Barriers

We specialize in providing affordable financial products and services for people and businesses in
low-to-moderate income and marginalized communities.

[Open an account][74]

## How Can We Help You Today?

[

### Credit Union + CDFI

CDFI stands for Community Development Financial Institution. It means we’re designed to make loans
in communities mainstream lenders often overlook—and to work with you, not just your credit score.

][75] [

### First-Time Homebuyer Help

Financial assistance and support may be available for first-time homebuyers—or for those who haven’t
owned a home in the last 3 years.

][76] [

### Get Loan-Ready

We look beyond credit scores—but a strong application still matters. Get clear steps to improve your
chances before you apply.

][77] [

### Financial Education & Coaching (Free 1:1)

Get supportive, judgment-free guidance for your money questions. Confidential and free.

][78]

Boston Children’s is proud to join the Broad Institute and The Jackson Laboratory to launch the
Center for Therapeutic Genetics (CTG) — a new collaboration advancing genetic medicines for rare
diseases.

Fewer than 1 in 20 rare diseases currently has an approved treatment. CTG is working to change that
by building scalable approaches to develop personalized therapies faster and expand access for more
patients and families.

Led by Boston Children’s Drs. Wendy Chung and Timothy Yu, alongside collaborators Dr. David Liu, Dr.
Cat Lutz, and Dr. Winston Yan, this effort brings together leaders in genetics to make
individualized medicine more efficient, accessible, and repeatable.

## BHVI INVENTS, PROTOTYPES AND LICENSES INNOVATIVE CONTACT LENS DESIGNS, SPECTACLE LENS DESIGNS AND
## INTRAOCULAR LENSES.

Through our partnership with ophthalmic industry leaders, our designs correct refractive errors and
slow the progression of myopia for millions of wearers worldwide.

### BHVI patenting and licensing

BHVI protects its lens designs by obtaining patents in markets worldwide. It then licenses those
designs to the market leaders in the ophthalmic industry.

[ Read more ][25]

### Our Myopia Calculator

The BHVI Myopia Calculator provides industry and practitioners with myopia management options,
demonstrating the benefits, over time, of treating myopia progression.

[ Read more ][26]

### Strategic Plan 2025

[ Read more ][27]

### About BHVI

Brien Holden Vision Institute (BHVI) is not-for-profit research & development organisation working
in the ophthalmic space. It is a company limited by guarantee, incorporated in Australia. It is
regulated by the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC).

### The Charity Programs (ACNC)
* Ophthalmic R&D in myopia, presbyopia, astigmatism (Diseases & Conditions).
* Optometry Education & Knowledge (Higher Education).
* Clinical and metrology services to support R & D technology development (Diseases & Conditions).

The assets and income of BHVI are applied solely towards the promotion and furtherance of the
objects of the Company as set out in its constitution.

## BHVI INVENTS, PROTOTYPES AND LICENSES INNOVATIVE CONTACT LENS DESIGNS, SPECTACLE LENS DESIGNS AND
## INTRAOCULAR LENSES.

Through our partnership with ophthalmic industry leaders, our designs correct refractive errors and
slow the progression of myopia for millions of wearers worldwide.

### BHVI patenting and licensing

BHVI protects its lens designs by obtaining patents in markets worldwide. It then licenses those
designs to the market leaders in the ophthalmic industry.

[ Read more ][25]

### Our Myopia Calculator

The BHVI Myopia Calculator provides industry and practitioners with myopia management options,
demonstrating the benefits, over time, of treating myopia progression.

[ Read more ][26]

### Strategic Plan 2025

[ Read more ][27]

### About BHVI

Brien Holden Vision Institute (BHVI) is not-for-profit research & development organisation working
in the ophthalmic space. It is a company limited by guarantee, incorporated in Australia. It is
regulated by the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC).

### The Charity Programs (ACNC)
* Ophthalmic R&D in myopia, presbyopia, astigmatism (Diseases & Conditions).
* Optometry Education & Knowledge (Higher Education).
* Clinical and metrology services to support R & D technology development (Diseases & Conditions).

The assets and income of BHVI are applied solely towards the promotion and furtherance of the
objects of the Company as set out in its constitution.

# United In Vision

CooperVision Specialty EyeCare represents the bringing together of the knowledge, experience, and
bold lineage of the world's leading specialty vision companies united for the benefit of today’s eye
care professionals and the patients they serve.

We embrace the concept that no two eyes, no two patients, and no two days are ever alike. Our team
delivers best-in-class service and a wide array of life-changing specialty lenses employed for the
successful treatment of myopia management, scleral and advanced contact lens management, and
presbyopia management.

## Innovative Products from CooperVision Specialty EyeCare

[Image]

### Myopia Management

Myopia continues to grow at alarming rates worldwide—especially among children. We offer
practitioners an unmatched portfolio of Ortho-K lenses that positively impacts both vision and
quality of life for your patients.
[Image]

### Sclerals and Advanced Contact Lens Management

Our portfolio of scleral and corneal GP lenses arm eye care professionals with a toolkit of contact
lens designs to address any eye shape, size or indication. Online fitting tools, design options, and
unrivaled parameter selection put practitioners in control to create truly custom lenses.
[Image]

### Presbyopia Management

We offer a wide array of easy to fit multifocal lenses that provide excellent vision, comfort, and
corneal integrity for emerging, midlife, and mature presbyopic patients. Portfolio includes aspheric
and bi-aspheric multifocal GP lenses as well as scleral multifocals.

scleral lens that gives you all the parameter controls needed for a truly customized scleral lens –
ideal for highly irregular, post-surgical, and OSD applications.

About Us
**An Introduction**

How far man has come with technological advancements is no secret. By constantly investing in
technologically advanced resources, **DP Tradelink **has come into existence to offer **Infusion
Set, Hydrophobic Aspheric Optic IOL, Urine Collecting Bag, Hydrophilic Spheric Optic IOL **and more
of nonpareil quality. For fulfilling the increasing requirements of our quality-marked products
globally, we have set up a widespread network sprawling worldwide. By exporting 50 percent of our
offerings Internationally, especially in the markets of **Tunisia**, we have become a renowned
**exporter** of aforesaid and more products. We also work as a **manufacturer** of these products.
For the same reason, we constantly innovate our products and improve our processes.

**Why Us?**

Best customer service, reliable solutions, quality-approved product range, easy payment options and
ethical business policy are a few of many reasons owing to which we are seen as a reliable business
partner. However, these are not the only factors that make us the best. A few more are cited below:

* **Modern design**: We use the advanced technology for manufacturing our offered range as per the
  requirements of our customers.
* **Creative Design**: The product designers of our company always understand the requirements of
  doctors, customers and patients to bring the most creative designs.
* **Round the clock support**: We solve all the queries of our customers within the shortest time
  period possible.
* **Affordable**: Apart from quality, it is the affordable price range for which our Urine
  Collecting Bag, Infusion Set, etc., are loved by all.
* **Business growth**: We are a progressive company and stay competitive in the market, we keep
  improving ourselves at business aspects.
* **Market strategy**: We incorporate modern market strategies in our work for enhancing the sales
  of our products.

**Our Team and Network**

The professional work environment at our workplace supports us to make active contributions in
bringing forth advanced Infusion Set, Urine Collecting Bag, etc. Our team of responsible quality
analysts keep exploring several possibilities to enhance the product quality at cost-effective
prices. Besides, by observing mutually settled delivery schedules, we have set up a widespread
supply chain network. This network eases our job of delivering orders within the committed time
frame Nationally and Internationally, both. Through this network, we also offer door-to-door
services to our customers.

**Our Values**

Innovation, quality, integrity, honesty and efficiency are our business values that are the
foundation of our business culture. Adhering to these values, our employees carry out their business
activities with efficiency. With our values, we have been fostering a culture that motivates
professionalism.

Hi, I’m Dr Leo Seo Wei.
I find joy in helping patients of diverse ages and backgrounds, protecting their sight.

As part of the global ophthalmic community actively pursuing medical breakthroughs to preserve
eyesight, witnessing the profound impact our efforts have on the lives of others brings me immense
satisfaction.

I love the fact that as an ophthalmologist, I get to deliver a good mix of internal medicine and
surgical care to my patients. For the newborns and preverbal little ones who are facing visual
development issues like crossed eyes and lazy eye or children who have started schooling and are
developing myopia quickly. Not forgetting those of us with age-related conditions like cataract,
glaucoma and diabetic eye disease, as we enter middle age and beyond!

[Dr Leo Seo Wei - Senior Consultant Ophthalmologist]
Hi, I’m Dr Leo Seo Wei.
I find joy in helping patients of diverse ages and backgrounds, protecting their sight.

As part of the global ophthalmic community actively pursuing medical breakthroughs to preserve
eyesight, witnessing the profound impact our efforts have on the lives of others brings me immense
satisfaction.

I love the fact that as an ophthalmologist, I get to deliver a good mix of internal medicine and
surgical care to my patients. For the newborns and preverbal little ones who are facing visual
development issues like crossed eyes and lazy eye or children who have started schooling and are
developing myopia quickly. Not forgetting those of us with age-related conditions like cataract,
glaucoma and diabetic eye disease, as we enter middle age and beyond!

The Eye Encyclopedia written by Eye Physicians and Surgeons

EyeWiki is where ophthalmologists, other physicians, patients, and the public can learn about the
vast spectrum of eye disease, diagnosis, and treatment. Any qualified ophthalmologist or

site is a collaboration between the [American Academy of Ophthalmology][17] and [more than a dozen
societies][18].

# Welcome to EyeWiki

The Eye Encyclopedia written by Eye Physicians and Surgeons

EyeWiki is where ophthalmologists, other physicians, patients, and the public can learn about the
vast spectrum of eye disease, diagnosis, and treatment. Any qualified ophthalmologist or
ophthalmologist in training is [invited to contribute content to the wiki][16]. The work on this
site is a collaboration between the [American Academy of Ophthalmology][17] and [more than a dozen
societies][18].

Access EyeWiki on the [**AAO Ophthalmic Education app**][19].

## “Together, we can tackle myopia in children”

Myopia progression can be controlled, not only corrected. Most spectacle lenses simply help the
child see clearly. While they correct vision, they don't help manage how myopia progresses over time
- that's why HOYA created MiYOSMART. At HOYA Vision Care, we are committed to helping children see
clearly and live fuller, more confident lives.

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

What Patients Ask Most About LASIK & PRK

## Common Questions

LASIK is one of the most popular and studied elective procedure in the world. Learn more about the
procedure cost, process and safety.

What is LASIK Eye Surgery?

LASIK (Laser-Assisted In Situ Keratomileusis) is a laser eye surgery that corrects refractive
errors, such as nearsightedness (myopia), farsightedness (hyperopia), and astigmatism. The laser
procedure itself is quick and painless, often less than 60 seconds per eye. After the procedure,
many patients see improved vision within 24 to 48 hours.

Can LASIK or PRK fix my vision?

LASIK and PRK can often correct nearsightedness, farsightedness, and astigmatism by reshaping your
cornea for clearer vision. Find out if you’re a candidate with a free consultation.

How much does LASIK or PRK cost?

According to Market Scope’s recent US Ophthalmologist Survey, LASIK costs typically range from
$1,500 to $5,000 per eye nationwide. At Lasik***Plus***, our all-inclusive price for modern,
all-laser LASIK starts between $2,495 – $2,595 per eye, but with promotions or vision discounts,
many patients pay closer to $1,900 per eye. 

Is LASIK or PRK safe?

Both LASIK and PRK are **very safe and highly effective** for treating nearsightedness,
farsightedness, and astigmatism. According to ophthalmic science journals, serious complications are
rare (<1%), and the vast majority of patients are thrilled with their outcomes. All surgeries have
risks but research has shown that serious complications are extremely rare and that the majority of
patients are happy with the results.

# Lumibird Medical

## Lighting the way
## **in patient care**

[ Learn more ][75]

**Lumibird Medical**, the Medical division of the Lumibird Group specialising in laser technologies,
offers healthcare professionals around the world a wide range of diagnostic and treatment solutions
through 3 medical equipment brands: **Quantel Medical, Ellex, and Optotek Medical**.

Our mission is to** collaborate closely with healthcare professionals**, empowering them to achieve
exceptional patient outcomes. By leveraging our collective expertise and cutting-edge innovations,
we enable medical professionals to **deliver reliable, transformative care**.

 

## Innovation in** Ophthalmology, Interventional Imaging, and OEM solutions**

Lumibird Medical drives advancements in three key areas.
* In *Ophthalmology*, we provide **diagnostic and therapeutic tools** for conditions like cataracts,
  glaucoma, dry eye and AMD.
* Our *Interventional Imaging* solutions, including portable ultrasounds and microendoscopy,
  **enhance minimally invasive procedures** in fields like emergency and sports medicine.
* Finally, our *OEM Solutions* deliver tailored,** certified laser and imaging technology** across
  specialties, supported from R&D through maintenance.
  

Through precision, innovation, and partnerships, we improve patient outcomes and support medical
professionals worldwide.

# Lumibird Medical

## Lighting the way
## **in patient care**

[ Learn more ][75]

**Lumibird Medical**, the Medical division of the Lumibird Group specialising in laser technologies,
offers healthcare professionals around the world a wide range of diagnostic and treatment solutions
through 3 medical equipment brands: **Quantel Medical, Ellex, and Optotek Medical**.

Our mission is to** collaborate closely with healthcare professionals**, empowering them to achieve
exceptional patient outcomes. By leveraging our collective expertise and cutting-edge innovations,
we enable medical professionals to **deliver reliable, transformative care**.

 

## Innovation in** Ophthalmology, Interventional Imaging, and OEM solutions**

Lumibird Medical drives advancements in three key areas.
* In *Ophthalmology*, we provide **diagnostic and therapeutic tools** for conditions like cataracts,
  glaucoma, dry eye and AMD.
* Our *Interventional Imaging* solutions, including portable ultrasounds and microendoscopy,
  **enhance minimally invasive procedures** in fields like emergency and sports medicine.
* Finally, our *OEM Solutions* deliver tailored,** certified laser and imaging technology** across
  specialties, supported from R&D through maintenance.
  

Through precision, innovation, and partnerships, we improve patient outcomes and support medical
professionals worldwide.

# Scotland’s first Myopia Management Clinic established in 2013

Myopia Management in Scotland — Help Slow Down Your Child’s Short‑Sightedness.

[ Request an Appointment ][15]

## Award‑winning care. World‑class expertise. Evidence‑based myopia control.

If your child struggles to see the whiteboard at school, signs on the road, or the TV clearly, they
may have myopia (short‑sightedness). Myopia usually means close vision is clear but distance vision
is blurred.

The challenge is that in many children, myopia is progressive—it can worsen year on year as the eye
grows. Higher levels of myopia are linked with increased lifetime risk of eye disease, which is why
early management matters.

At Peter Ivins Eye Care, we go beyond “stronger glasses every year”. We offer a dedicated clinic
designed to measure, monitor and manage progressive myopia with the latest proven treatments.

## Why Choose Peter Ivins Eye Care?

### We’ve been leading myopia care in Scotland for over a decade:

#### Scotland’s first dedicated Myopia Management Clinic (launched 2013)

Helping hundreds of young people slow their myopia progression since.

#### Scotland’s first practice to install the Oculus Myopia Master (April 2021)

Enabling objective measurement of axial length (eye length) and monitoring of myopia progression
over time.

#### Recognised expertise & professional contribution

Craig McArthur has contributed to professional education on myopia and myopia management, including
Optometry Today’s myopia guide.

### Always at the front of innovation

Axial Length measurement

Corneal topography

Ultra widefield retinal imaging, OCT and OCT-Angiography
Ocumetra mEYE® Suite 

## What is myopia

Myopia (short‑sightedness) is when the eye focuses light in front of the retina, making distant
objects blurry. It’s increasingly common in children worldwide.

### What causes myopia to progress?

Progression is influenced by multiple factors, including:

**Genetics:** children with myopic parents have higher risk.

**Near work & screen habits:** increased close work is associated with rising myopia prevalence.

**Environment / outdoor time:** reduced outdoor time is associated with increased risk and
progression.

## What is myopia management

Myopia management is a proactive approach to help slow the worsening of short‑sightedness during
childhood—rather than only updating glasses. ZEISS summarises this clearly: standard single‑vision
correction can improve clarity, but it typically doesn’t address progression.

The aim is to reduce the rate at which the eye grows longer, helping to lower the chance of high
myopia later on.

## The Myopia Management Exam

Our assessment is more comprehensive than a standard sight test because we need to understand both
vision and eye growth.

### Step 1

#### Understand your child’s myopia pattern

We take a detailed history and assess risk factors (family history, visual habits and lifestyle).
This is part of building a personalised plan.

### Step 2

#### Accurate refraction & vision assessment

We precisely assess your child’s prescription and visual system to ensure clear vision and safe
management.

### Step 3

#### Eye health checks

Myopia management should always include appropriate ocular health evaluation and regular
reviews—particularly as myopia increases risk over time.

### Step 4

#### Axial length measurement
#### (Oculus Myopia Master)

In April 2021, we installed Scotland’s first Oculus Myopia Master, which allows us to measure axial
length—the length of the eye.
Why it matters:
* Axial length helps identify children at risk and provides an objective way to track progression.
* Repeat measurements let us see whether treatment is working and change strategy if needed.

### Step 5

#### Personalised treatment plan

Based on findings, we recommend the most suitable options from:
* Myopia control soft contact lenses
* Orthokeratology (night lenses), and/or specialist spectacle lenses.
* Specialist spectacle lenses (SightGlass Vision, MiYOSMART, Stellest etc)

Correction makes vision clear; myopia management aims to **slow progression** over time.

### Why measure axial length?

Axial length tracks eye growth. Measuring and repeating it helps monitor progression and whether
treatment is working.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]

**At Tenpoint Therapeutics^{™},** we’re rejuvenating vision for the aging eye. By understanding
real-world needs and partnering with eye care professionals, **we’re setting a new standard for
presbyopia care.**

## Presbyopia is just the beginning

[Presbyopia ][17]is a gradual loss of near visual acuity that typically begins around the age 50 and
significantly affects aging eyes and may significantly affect quality of life if left
uncorrected.^{1-3}

#### We’re prioritizing:

Presbyopia affects people daily, **making it difficult to read and manage work or social
activities.^{2,4}**

the day, without significant limitations.^{5,6}**

# You’re Not Powerless Against Your Child’s Worsening Vision

Don’t settle for your child getting stronger glasses every year.

We treat the root cause to stop myopia (nearsightedness) in its tracks—**proven, non-surgical
treatments**.

[ Is My Child at Risk? ][33]
[ Book Free Consultation ][34]

## Stronger Glasses Only Mask Your Child's Nearsightedness (Myopia)

[boy-using-mobile-with-nearsightedness-stellast-eyeglasses]

**The Reality:** a worsening prescription is a warning. Standard glasses give clear vision, but they
don't treat the underlying issue. Treehouse Eyes doctors have the expertise and equipment to address
the root cause—slowing or even stopping myopia from getting worse.
* **Regular Glasses:** Clear the blur, but leave the disease untreated.
* **Treehouse Eyes Doctors:** have the expertise and equipment to address the root cause to slow or
  stop myopia from getting worse.

Every prescription change matters. Don’t wait for their next “annual eye exam” to see if it’s gotten
worse.

Myopia isn't one-size-fits-all. Our doctors use proven, non-invasive treatments to find the right
path for your child’s unique lifestyle.

[ [sm-treehouse-eyes-icon] ][39]

### [ Custom Soft Contact Lenses ][40]

Correct your child’s vision all day while the specialized design slows their myopic progression.

Usually placed into the eye at night, these drops are a great option for children not ready for
contact lenses.

Special prescription glasses that provide clear vision while slowing myopic progression.

# You’re Not Powerless Against Your Child’s Worsening Vision

Don’t settle for your child getting stronger glasses every year.

We treat the root cause to stop myopia (nearsightedness) in its tracks—**proven, non-surgical
treatments**.

[ Is My Child at Risk? ][33]
[ Book Free Consultation ][34]

## Stronger Glasses Only Mask Your Child's Nearsightedness (Myopia)

[boy-using-mobile-with-nearsightedness-stellast-eyeglasses]

**The Reality:** a worsening prescription is a warning. Standard glasses give clear vision, but they
don't treat the underlying issue. Treehouse Eyes doctors have the expertise and equipment to address
the root cause—slowing or even stopping myopia from getting worse.
* **Regular Glasses:** Clear the blur, but leave the disease untreated.
* **Treehouse Eyes Doctors:** have the expertise and equipment to address the root cause to slow or
  stop myopia from getting worse.

Every prescription change matters. Don’t wait for their next “annual eye exam” to see if it’s gotten
worse.

path for your child’s unique lifestyle.

Correct your child’s vision all day while the specialized design slows their myopic progression.

Worn during sleep, they gently & safely reshape the front surface of the eye. This allows your child

contact lenses.

Special prescription glasses that provide clear vision while slowing myopic progression.

# Upstate South Carolina BUSINESS MOVES HERE

## Welcome

Come discover what BMW, Michelin, GE Vernova, and more than 2,938 engineering and manufacturing
companies already know: **Upstate South Carolina is what a competitive advantage looks like.** Home
to 590 international companies, the Upstate is the ideal place to start or expand your business.

 

**In Upstate SC, ten thriving counties come together to form one region where global business feels
at home.** See our region’s Southern charm, thriving industries, and bright minds in action.

### The #1 Exporter for Passenger Automobiles

South Carolina is the #1 state for exports of passenger vehicles by value, with $9.8 billion in
sales for 2025.

[ [READ MORE] ][103]

### The Nation's #1 Tire Exporter

For the 11th consecutive year, South Carolina was the national leader in the export of tires, with
sales reaching $2 billion, representing 43% of the total U.S. market share. South Carolina is home
to many of the world’s leading tire manufacturers, including Upstate-based Michelin and Trelleborg
as well as Bridgestone, Continental Tire and Giti Tire.

 

[ [READ MORE] ][104]

### A National Leader in Turbine Production

GE Vernova’s Upstate campus began manufacturing gas turbines in 1968. A major player in the global
power generation market, the company announced in January 2025 a $160 million investment in its
Greenville facility and 650 new jobs.

# Goodbye squint: Say hello to the fuss-less presbyopia treatment – eye drops for blurry close up
# vision

[Actor portrayal of presbyopia patient having difficulty reading up close due to presbyopia] [Actor
portrayal of presbyopia patient having difficulty reading up close due to presbyopia]

Actor portrayal

## Struggling to see things up close?

As our eyes age, close-up vision can become blurry, a condition called [presbyopia][29]. Simple
things like reading, texting, or just checking a label at the store may become harder.

[Actor portrayal of man using YUVEZZI eye drops]

Once a day presbyopia eye drops

It’s as easy as one and done, just one drop per eye, once a day. With [**up to 8 hours**][30] of
sharp, close-up vision*, YUVEZZI is a fuss-less eye drop for presbyopia that can be used your way:

[YUVEZZI with or without glasses icon ]

On its own **instead of** reading glasses

OR
[YUVEZZI with or without contacts icon ]

**With contacts** or glasses you use to see far away^{†}

^{*}

About half of people in medical studies could read close up at hour 8, as measured by reading at
least 3 or more lines on an eye chart in low light without losing distance vision.

^{†}

If you wear contact lenses, remove them before using YUVEZZI. Wait at least 10 minutes after using
YUVEZZI before you put them back in your eyes.

Actor portrayal

[YUVEZZI as an alternative to laser eye surgery for presbyopia icon]

## **Instead of surgery for presbyopia, such as lens implants, YUVEZZI prescription eye drops are a
## less invasive step you can take.**

[Eight hours of sharp, up-close vision icon]
Up to 8 hours of sharp, close-up vision*

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

Do not use YUVEZZI if you are allergic to any of its ingredients or if you currently have
inflammation of the iris (iritis).

Before taking YUVEZZI, tell your doctor if you have depression, low blood pressure, or circulation
problems.

YUVEZZI may cause temporary blurry, dim, or dark vision. If you experience this, avoid driving,
using machinery, and participating in hazardous activities. Use caution when night driving and in
other activities in low light.

Call your doctor right away if you suddenly have flashes of light, floaters, or vision loss. 

Do not let the tip of the vial touch your eye, eyelid, or any other surface.

The most common side effects of YUVEZZI are headache, impaired vision, and eye pain and/or eye
irritation upon use. These are not all of the possible side effects of YUVEZZI. 

Most side effects were generally mild, didn’t last long, and went away on their own. 

You are encouraged to report negative side effects of prescription drugs to the FDA. Visit
[www.fda.gov/medwatch][34], or call 1-800-FDA-1088.

**Please see the **[**Brief Summary**][35]** for more information.**

### USE

YUVEZZI is a prescription eye drop for adults with blurry close-up vision due to age.

## Struggling to see things up close?

As our eyes age, close-up vision can become blurry, a condition called [presbyopia][29]. Simple
things like reading, texting, or just checking a label at the store may become harder.

[Actor portrayal of man using YUVEZZI eye drops]

Once a day presbyopia eye drops

It’s as easy as one and done, just one drop per eye, once a day. With [**up to 8 hours**][30] of
sharp, close-up vision*, YUVEZZI is a fuss-less eye drop for presbyopia that can be used your way:

[YUVEZZI with or without glasses icon ]

On its own **instead of** reading glasses

OR
[YUVEZZI with or without contacts icon ]

**With contacts** or glasses you use to see far away^{†}

^{*}

About half of people in medical studies could read close up at hour 8, as measured by reading at
least 3 or more lines on an eye chart in low light without losing distance vision.

^{†}

If you wear contact lenses, remove them before using YUVEZZI. Wait at least 10 minutes after using
